text:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a sustained increase in 429s and queue latency from the us-central2 GPU fleet starting ~09:12 UTC. A subset of nodes are reporting NIC driver timeouts and several pods evicted.
jon: Confirmed. Metrics: per-gpu-util down but connection retries spiking. Some preemptible nodetypes kicked too. I'm seeing a 28% effective capacity loss on the pool.
ops-bot: [alert] us-central2-gpu-pool: node-failure-rate > 5% over 10m; eviction_count=47; avg_request_latency +2.4s
ravindra: Can we get a quick capacity dump? I want top tenant usage in the affected pool.
leo: Running: rctl describe pool us-central2-gpu --json | jq '.nodes|length, .evictions, .tenant_usage|sort_by(.tokens)|reverse[:10]'
leo: ```
72
47
[
  {"tenant":"big-adtech-1","tokens":120M},
  {"tenant":"video-gen-ops","tokens":85M},
  {"tenant":"search-inc","tokens":60M},
  {"tenant":"startup-x","tokens":22M},
  ...
]
```
kai: Big-adtech-1 + video-gen-ops + search-inc are the top noisy tenants. If we don't act they'll consume remaining capacity and push others into 503/429.
maria: Proposal: temporary per-tenant softcaps for top 5 tenants, drop burst windows from 10s to 2s, enable cross-region fallback to us-east1 for non-sensitive requests, and apply short-lived quota reductions (30%) for noisy tenants. Any objections?
jon: +1. Also we should do a live reroute policy: prefer local until 2s queue latency then route to fallback region. Add a cost flag since cross-region will increase spend.
ravindra: I'll prepare throttle commands. Sequence: 1) apply per-tenant softcap, 2) set route fallback policy, 3) open support CC to impacted customers.
ravindra: Commands I'm planning to run:
```
trafficctl tenant throttle set --tenant big-adtech-1 --pool us-central2 --tps 0.6
trafficctl tenant throttle set --tenant video-gen-ops --pool us-central2 --tps 0.5
trafficctl tenant throttle set --tenant search-inc --pool us-central2 --tps 0.6
routectl update --pool us-central2 --fallback-region us-east1 --latency-threshold 2000
```
maria: Use softcap mode (allow queued but limit token-rate), not hard reject, so customers see degraded tails but not immediate failures. Add metric tags so we can revert by label.
leo: I'll add the metric tags. Also setting alert to page again if 5xx rate > 1% after changes.
oncall-bot: @oncall-sre paging now
kai: Customer comms — I can draft short messages for the top 3 tenants. Offer temporary free capacity credit if their SLAs were impacted. Keep it minimal.
maria: Good. Assignments: ravindra execute throttle commands (in 1m), leo add tags and alerting, jon run the fallback route change, kai draft comms. I'll coordinate with growth for credits.
ravindra: Executing first batch now.
ravindra: ```
# applied softcaps
trafficctl> OK big-adtech-1: softcap(tps=0.6) applied
trafficctl> OK video-gen-ops: softcap(tps=0.5) applied
trafficctl> OK search-inc: softcap(tps=0.6) applied
```
leo: Tags + alerts in place: tagging changes with incident=1902345678 and annotating dashboards.
jon: Route change pushed — fallthrough enabled to us-east1 for non-PII routes. Monitor costs.
maria: Early signal: 429s dropped 35% in 3m, overall tail latencies improving but some queued requests move to us-east1. Cost projection: additional egress/region-cost ~ estimated $1.8k/hr if sustained.
kai: Drafts for customers ready, pinging growth and support for sign-off. Suggest phrasing emphasizing we're limiting bursts to stabilize the fleet and no data moved to external regions for private deployments.
ops-bot: [update] incident=1902345678: softcaps applied; fallback enabled; 429 rate -31% vs t-10m
maria: OK — keep monitoring for 30m. If evictions continue or 5xx>1% escalate to full region failover plan (notify infra-leads). We'll plan a postmortem once stabilized. Thanks all.
kai: I'll post customer comms once legal signs off.
ravindra: Monitoring shows one node group (driver-version 0.9.4) with most failures. I'll open a task to cordon those and roll to 0.9.6 after stabilization.
maria: Good catch — add to postmortem: driver rollout/validation gap and noisy-tenant throttling thresholds. Closing loop in 30m for next steps.
